metaShifts.description: Building on 7.34b's support rebalancing, this patch further redistributes power among supports. Previously nerfed heroes like Witch Doctor receive mixed adjustments (faster cast point but lower damage), while Vengeful Spirit faces comprehensive nerfs after her 7.34b buffs proved excessive. Meanwhile, underperforming supports like Shadow Shaman, Dazzle, and Omniknight receive significant buffs, continuing the trend of evening out support viability.

After 7.34b focused on melee carry corrections, this patch shifts toward empowering ranged carries. Sniper receives substantial buffs (range and damage), Clinkz gets comprehensive improvements, and Muerta sees significant damage increases. This represents a meta shift away from the melee carry dominance that characterized recent patches, potentially favoring more defensive, positioning-based gameplay.

Following 7.34b's Invoker containment, this patch continues nerfing dominant mid heroes while buffing struggling ones. Invoker faces further nerfs (health regen, movement speed, spell damage), while Zeus receives comprehensive buffs and Windranger gets base stat improvements. This suggests a deliberate effort to create mid lane diversity after the Universal Invoker era.

Extending 7.34b's utility-focused offlane buffs, this patch heavily favors teamfight-oriented offlaners. Axe receives comprehensive buffs, Magnus gets range improvements, Centaur gains mobility, and Bristleback sees further enhancements. This continues the trend away from pure lane dominators toward heroes who excel in mid-game teamfights and objective control.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Axe's increased Berserker's Call radius (300→315) and damage buffs synergize perfectly with Blink Dagger's initiation potential, making his signature combo more reliable and impactful in teamfights.

Sniper's increased Take Aim range (130/220/310/400) stacks multiplicatively with Hurricane Pike's range bonus, creating unprecedented positioning safety for a hero that also received significant damage buffs.
Zeus's reduced Thundergod's Wrath cooldown and mana cost makes double-ultimate combos more accessible and frequent, while his improved Lightning Bolt ministun enhances setup potential for the combo.
Magnus's increased base attack range (150→200) makes Echo Sabre's double-hit more reliable in teamfights, while his improved Reverse Polarity radius creates better positioning for follow-up attacks.
Clinkz's buffed Burning Barrage damage (65%→75%) and improved Strafe scaling synergize with Desolator's armor reduction, creating devastating burst potential in his ultimate form.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Invoker's reduced base health regen and movement speed nerfs make him more vulnerable during the long cooldowns between Refresher combos, while his spell damage nerfs reduce the impact of double-casting.

Gyrocopter's increased Flak Cannon cooldown and reduced agility gain significantly diminish the value of Scepter's global Flak Cannon, as the ability is less frequently available and hits for less damage.
Vengeful Spirit's comprehensive nerfs (Wave of Terror mana cost, Vengeance Aura damage) combined with Solar Crest's movement speed nerf (18%→15%) reduce her ability to enable carries effectively.
Treant's increased cooldowns on Nature's Grasp, Leech Seed, and Overgrowth reduce the frequency of Shard's enhanced root effects, making the item less impactful overall.

Carry.explanation: Comprehensive buffs to Take Aim range and Assassinate damage make him a premier late-game carry with unmatched positioning safety and burst potential.
Significant improvements to Burning Barrage damage and Strafe scaling, plus Death Pact talent buff, enhance his carry potential in both farming and teamfighting phases.
Dead Shot damage increase and Pierce the Veil bonus damage buff significantly improve her carry scaling and teamfight contribution.

Mid.explanation: Comprehensive buffs to Lightning Bolt ministun, Thundergod's Wrath cooldown and mana cost create a more impactful and sustainable mid-game presence.
Base stat improvements (agility and intelligence) plus Gale Force mana reduction enhance her laning phase and spell sustainability.
Base intelligence increase and Life Drain mana cost reduction improve his laning and teamfight sustainability as a mid laner.

Offlane.explanation: Berserker's Call radius increase, Culling Blade damage buff, and talent improvements make him a more reliable teamfight initiator and finisher.
Increased base attack range and Reverse Polarity radius improve his teamfight initiation and follow-up potential significantly.
Movement speed increase, Stampede cooldown reduction, and Work Horse improvements enhance his mobility and teamfight impact.
Base damage increase and Viscous Nasal Goo armor reduction buffs improve his laning dominance and scaling potential.

SoftSupport.explanation: Hex cast range increase and Mass Serpent Ward cooldown reduction significantly improve his disable potential and objective control capabilities.
Mind Flare intelligence multiplier increase, Spiked Carapace cooldown reduction, and Vendetta improvements enhance his ganking and teamfight potential.
Charge of Darkness speed increase and Nether Strike damage buff improve his ganking effectiveness and teamfight contribution.

HardSupport.explanation: Base armor and intelligence increases improve her survivability and mana pool, addressing key weaknesses in the support role.
Intelligence gain increase, Bad Juju health cost reduction, and attack speed talent buff enhance his support capabilities and scaling.
Repel mana cost and cooldown reductions make him a more sustainable and impactful support throughout the game.

Carry.explanation: Agility gain reduction, Flak Cannon cooldown increase, and Homing Missile stun duration nerf significantly reduce his farming speed and teamfight impact.
Base damage decrease and health talent nerf weaken his already fragile early game and reduce his late-game survivability.
Base health regen reduction and Mirror Image mana cost increase hurt her farming sustainability and split-push effectiveness.

Mid.explanation: Base health regen reduction, Wex movement speed nerf, and Tornado damage decrease continue his decline from the Universal status peak.
Severe base health regen reduction and Sleight of Fist mana increase significantly hurt his laning sustainability and spell spam potential.
Base intelligence decrease and talent nerfs reduce his spell sustainability and roaming effectiveness from the mid position.

Offlane.explanation: Comprehensive cooldown increases on Nature's Grasp, Leech Seed, and Overgrowth reduce his teamfight frequency and laning pressure.
Vacuum damage decrease and Surge cooldown increase hurt his farming efficiency and teamfight initiation capabilities.
Cinder Brew cooldown increase reduces his laning harassment and teamfight setup frequency.

SoftSupport.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs to Magic Missile shard, Wave of Terror mana cost, and Vengeance Aura damage significantly reduce her support effectiveness.
Hawk mana cost increase, health reduction, and Drums of Slom nerf hurt his vision control and sustain capabilities.
Roll Up cooldown increase and Swashbuckle talent nerf reduce his mobility and teamfight engagement frequency.

HardSupport.explanation: Hex cast range decrease at early levels significantly reduces his early game disable potential and positioning safety.
Strength gain reduction, Fatal Bonds duration decrease, and talent nerfs reduce his survivability and teamfight impact.
Fade Bolt damage reduction nerf significantly hurts his laning harassment and farming capability as a support.
